t: You're at Cadogan Gardens, a garden square in Chelsea that is part of the Cadogan Estate. It's a residential address with a few known names attached to it. The artist Bessie Hamilton Johnston, who lived from 1860 to 1943, lived here. So did John Verity, who lived from 1862 to 1905. And Anthea Lascelles, born in 1930, died here in 1976. There's not much more on record about them in the material I have, but it's a place that has quietly sheltered several lives.
